asr.full_text: Baba Saheb Bhim Rao Ambedkar said that if you think that I have worked only for the Bahujans Do read the constitution of India once Yes friends, I am RD Bharti and you are watching Bihari Sultan Today, we have brought to you such special subjects. whom you will be shocked when you hear such things. They use the word Dalit in political matters but if we try to mention something good they say that one should speak like the Indians. It is important that we are not saying something out of caste. But if you don't honor people they must be given the right to honor their caste. who do not get proper respect from Indian society. When it comes to respect, people start threatening me as well, say- say Indian don't do caste-based, I am not doing caste-based. I will tell you Superstar Raajni Kand of Bollywood, You must know, all his of his films on Box Office are hit films. They are in now. But not like this, as his time is ended but they are still in. He is from the dalit caste. He is from dalit society. Coming to politics. Bahaan Mayawati. Who has been in politics for a long time. And in the mainstream society, there is no other politician in the world who is as popular as him The international or the national media either one like Modi or like Bahandh Mayabati all are silent like nobody else Now, we will take forward to the cricket world. You must know the names of Binod-Kamli ji. He is an ex-cricketer and has always been a cricketer. But the Indian public does not appreciate him. I am talking about today cricketmen. Kedar-Jadhav From the Dalit community The entire Indian crew is dependent on him. Keidar Jadhav, a modern-day cricketer is a great friend of the Indian cricket team. When you watch race of athletes, just moment you saw, Himadashar got 5 gold medal, and at that 5 gold medal, they gave the cheque of Rs. 50,000. and our respected Modi Ji, gives a cheque of ₹ 100,000 on the 1st gold medal of PV Shandu. Then one has to say that there is a kind of distaste with Dalit society. If our society is not in line with Even your social media accounts are linked with Dalit community or from some community. If our world would not respect our people for nothing, we would not be worthy enough to respect them. We need to develop people's talent too. Who in your community will get to know about this? What are some of the articles and articles from caste laws related to RSS? Have you read your religious scriptures? People know the purpose of that constitution. Have you once read it? In which aspect did it appear? When you don't want to read the entire constitution, hoping that somebody else has become your heir. So the Baisakh is simply a baisakh. You must walk on your feet. And learn how to walk on your legs you have to learn to walk on your feet to count we can count the names of 1000 people Like Silpa Sinha, Prasad And then we have some more names there are too many names that we don't know I want to say this to all of you, show this video to children and teach them that there are talented people in our society. Please do not get influenced by these people. There is not a need to get talent from anywhere in this Dalit community. People like great singers, artists, painters all across the country are contacting me. Some ones keeps writing me something, by singing me. They also asked to discuss me with them. to be informed too and share my videos in your social media accounts, share my videos because i have to make this society bigger and more successful. Thank you guys for watching. We will bring you videos up to date and please take care of us before the bad time. Please comment down below our video tips.
